channel.title: Arizona Capitol Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Arizona Capitol Times (azcapitoltimes.com)

item.title: Will excess clemency hamper Hobbs’ re-election bid? | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: During her time in office, Hobbs has granted 21 clemency requests of the 35 recommended to her office, with three sent this year still pending.

item.title: Dueling ballot proposals compete to reform Arizona’s ESA program | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: Dueling ballot measures from public school groups and school choice advocates are both angling to reform the Empowerment Scholarship Account program.

item.title: Don’t gut Arizona’s middle housing law | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: If we won’t allow even the most basic forms of incremental housing reform in the urban cores of large cities, what hope do we have?

item.title: It’s time to rein in out-of-network billing abuse | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: Health care affordability is becoming a competitive vulnerability. I'm glad Arizona's legislators recognized the problem. Now it's time to finish the job.

item.title: Sunshine Week highlights the daily fight for government transparency | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: Sunshine Week is a good moment to celebrate transparency. It’s also a good moment to recommit to it — not just in principle, but in practice.

item.title: States target PBM pharmacy ownership in aggressive new push | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: State lawmakers are opening a new front in their battle with pharmacy benefit managers.

item.title: David Clouse: Law enforcement is a family tradition | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: Public safety has been a lifelong mission for Navajo County Sheriff David Clouse, whose family has a history of serving in the county's Sheriff's Office.

item.title: City officials warn proposed tax freeze could jeopardize water projects | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: Proposed tax freeze in Arizona could jeopardize water projects, city officials warn. Lawmakers' plan could limit ability to meet pressing needs.

item.title: HB 2375 preserves our historic districts, and that’s a good thing. | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: My community is not rich, racist, isolationist or unwelcoming. We want folks to join us in keeping historic districts alive and well.

item.title: Arizona lawyers up for potential Colorado River court battle | Arizona Capitol Times
item.description: Arizona is retaining legal counsel in preparation for a potential court battle over the Colorado River, according to Gov. Katie Hobbs’ office.
